cohort: 154 late preterm infants (34-36 weeks gestation) admitted to the Intensive Care Unit (ICU), Clinic for Children's Diseases, University Clinical Center Tuzla, between January 1, 2020 and December 31, 2022
finding: A younger gestational age at birth is associated with a greater risk of short-term complications among late preterm infants.
mod_finding: Male sex and birth weight were significantly and independently associated with an increased risk for respiratory morbidity.
